item: Climate: USGS earthquake monthly-count parser and consented fetch (A1/S2 row 3, fixtures only)
key_paths: src/stats/usgs_quakes.py; src/stats/fetch.py; tests/test_usgs_quakes.py; configs/external_artifacts.yml; docs/SECURITY.md; src/static/net-hosts.js
summary: Pure parser for the USGS ComCat FDSN CSV into monthly counts and monthly max magnitude at a stated threshold (worldwide; only type earthquake counted; explosions and blasts excluded and counted; thresholds under the 4.5 global completeness floor refused; the month in progress and future months are gaps with a stated reason; refusals counted; vintages caller-stamped; distinct agency us-usgs-earthquakes so the minerals feed is untouched). fetch_usgs_quakes behind the kill switch asks the service's own count first, refuses a window over the 20000-event maximum instead of truncating, and derives the body bound from the declared count. Registry entry usgs-quakes-csv-shape, a click-only Earthquake counts lane in the SECURITY.md table and the consent popup. Separate from the live hazards relay, which is untouched. Built on hand-made fixtures: the sandbox cannot reach the host, so the CSV shape is documented, not verified live. Release note: a response with fewer events than the service counted is refused instead of published as a smaller monthly count (found in the Opus read; a refused row also turns its month into a gap). Not yet shipped: store wiring, the Statistics/Agenda surface, per-series freshness, the button.
